Advanced features include MIDI-driven grain repitching via "Polly Mode" and timing adjustments through "Gravity Mode." The full software costs $49, while a simplified "Vortix Raw" version is available for free.

entry.title: DWP Releases Rift Glitch and Effects Plugin
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

DWP has released Rift, a glitch and effects performance plugin for macOS and Windows in VST3, AU, and AAX formats. The software features a dual workflow that supports both independent single-track operation and a shared multi-track workspace for Ableton Live via Max for Live.

Performance controls include settings for beat, length, pitch, and reverse probability, alongside eight effect snapshots per track. A companion Android app, Rift Remote, is also available to facilitate touch control over a local network when using the Max for Live workflow.
